title: Bounded flat sheaf-complex presentation of single base change before stalks
statement: Let p:Y -> B and g:A -> B be scheme morphisms, M an O_Y-module, and use the standard derived categories. A StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation is the proposition that there exists a cochain complex K of O_B-modules, with an integer upper support bound and flat terms, an isomorphism e:Rp_*M[0] -> Qh(qK), and an isomorphism t:Qh(g_*qK) -> Rp'_*(g' tensor-pullback M)[0]. Here g_* denotes ordinary tensor pullback on homotopy complexes, p' and g' are the canonical pullback projections, and q is the homotopy quotient. The canonical single comparison equals Lg*(e.hom), followed by the pinned derived tensor-pullback counit at qK, followed by t.hom. The predicate has no point, no module stalk, no choice of scalar derived pair, and no assertion that either counit or comparison is invertible. It only records an existential proposition, not a chosen complex.
